WITH filtered_keyword AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT k.id
    FROM keyword AS k
    WHERE k.keyword = '10,000-mile-club'
),
filtered_movie_keyword AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN filtered_keyword AS fk ON mk.keyword_id = fk.id
),
filtered_links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ml.movie_id, ml.linked_movie_id, ml.link_type_id
    FROM movie_link AS ml
    JOIN filtered_movie_keyword AS fm ON ml.movie_id = fm.movie_id
)
SELECT MIN(lt.link) AS link_type,
       MIN(t1.title) AS first_movie,
       MIN(t2.title) AS second_movie
FROM filtered_links AS fl
JOIN title AS t1 ON t1.id = fl.movie_id
JOIN title AS t2 ON t2.id = fl.linked_movie_id
JOIN link_type AS lt ON lt.id = fl.link_type_id
